page.overview:
What is Tower Farm?

The Tower Farm was located on the outskirts of Haddonfield. On Halloween, 1989, it was decided by the teens of Haddonfield to have a party at the farm, and things were going well that night. But, as it was getting late, they decided to have another party elsewhere. Three of the teens that attended the party (Tina Williams, Samantha Thomas and Spitz) would not make it to the other location, as they were all murdered by Michael Myers. Two policemen (Nick Ross and Tom Farrah) were also at the party as they were sent by Dr. Sam Loomis to watch over Tina Williams, yet they both fell to the pitchfork wielded by Michael Myers.

Six years later, Michael's niece, Jamie Lloyd, was also found murdered at the farm. Category:Locations
